weekLabel: Sun Nov 1 cook · Mon Nov 2 – Sun Nov 8
notes: Headcount 4 (Rory, Wendy, Chloe + 1 adult guest through Nov 8; no guest Tuesday). Tue Nov 3 = car dinner after dance + Wendy's bowl; Sat Nov 7 = night out. Mild for Chloe, heat on the side for Rory. Quality: organic; beef grass-fed/finished; chicken organic AND air-chilled only (Whole Foods this week, since Sprouts listings don't say air-chilled); seafood wild-caught; eggs OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free; yogurt Kalona grass-fed whole milk. Rice in bone broth; gelatin in beef. Low oil. Named low-cal sides. Macros are estimates.

costEstimates.label: Estimated · Sprouts prices · excl. tax/delivery
costEstimates.note: Sprouts $423.19 + Whole Foods $60.93 (air-chilled chicken + Bell & Evans nuggets). Unit prices from Oct 8–22 Sprouts lookups plus Oct 29 checks (WF air-chilled thighs $7.99/lb, Hero tortillas $8.29); items marked est are estimates. Unpriced: Noble isolate (check-off).

dinners.name: Cheeseburger bowls (grass-fed beef + 80/20 cauliflower rice)
dinners.desc: Rotation favorite (~60 g protein, under 600 cal, huge plate). Grass-fed 93% beef browned with gelatin and onion, over an 80/20 cauliflower-and-bone-broth-rice blend, with romaine, tomato, pickles, a little Grassmilk cheddar and a Kalona burger sauce. Cooked fresh at the end of the batch cook; no leftovers by design. Chloe's: beef, plain rice, cheddar, cucumber.
dinners.side: Romaine, tomato + dill pickle 'burger salad' built into the bowl

recipe.serves: 4 (cooked beef: Rory 170 g · guest 170 · Wendy 140 · Chloe 70; ~100 g spare)
ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) organic grass-fed 93% lean ground beef (fridge, from Saturday's delivery)
1 tsp (3 g) gelatin bloomed in 3 Tbsp (45 g) bone broth
½ yellow or red onion, finely diced (~80 g)
1¼ tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 Tbsp (15 g) organic ketchup, 1 tsp (5 g) yellow mustard
Rice blend (~700 g): 2 × 12 oz bags organic frozen riced cauliflower (680 g) + 140 g bone broth rice (from today's batch), ½ tsp salt. Plus 100 g plain bone broth rice for Chloe.
Burger salad (~400 g): 1 romaine heart chopped (~200 g), 2 Roma tomatoes diced (~200 g), 40 g organic dill pickle chips chopped
Kalona burger sauce (~150 g): 90 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt, 25 g organic ketchup, 20 g chopped dill pickles + 1 tsp brine, 10 g yellow mustard, ¼ tsp garlic powder, pinch of smoked paprika and salt
60 g Organic Valley Grassmilk cheddar, finely shredded (Rory 15 g)
Rory only: hot sauce on the side
steps: 4:55: bloom the gelatin in the broth 5 min. Stir the sauce together; chop the salad.

5:00: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high, spray once. Add the onion 2 min, then the beef; break it up and leave it 3–4 min to brown. Stir, season, add the ketchup, mustard and bloomed gelatin; cook 2–3 min until glossy and 160°F with no pink. No added oil; spoon off any fat if there is any.

5:05 (same time): riced cauliflower in a 10-in skillet or wide pan, dry over medium-high 7–8 min, stirring, until the water is gone. Fold in the 140 g bone broth rice and ½ tsp salt; 2 min more to steaming.
Build bowls: blend, beef, salad, cheddar, sauce. Chloe: 70 g beef, 100 g plain rice, cheddar, cucumber sticks.
Rory: 170 g beef, 250 g blend, 100 g salad, 30 g sauce, 15 g cheddar ≈ 551 cal / 58 g P.
recipe.leftovers: No planned leftovers (by design). Spare ~100 g beef → the next day's lunch, fridge, eat by Tue.

sideRecipes.title: Lemon-oregano chicken breasts (Sunday, for the 'fire' lunches + Tue car dinner)
sideRecipes.serves: 3 lb raw → ~1,020 g cooked: 3 × 200 g lunches + 370 g for Tuesday (Rory 160 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 60) + ~50 g spare
ingredients: 3 lb (1.36 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in
Zest of 1 lemon + 30 g lemon juice
2 g (1 tsp) dried oregano, 4 g (1½ tsp) garlic powder, 2 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika
9 g (1½ tsp) kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon, spices and salt; spray lightly.
Air-fry at 380°F 14–18 min per batch (don't stack), flipping halfway, to 165°F. Rest 5 min, slice.
Portion (fridge): 3 lunch containers × 200 g, 1 Tuesday container of 370 g.

sideRecipes.title: Rory's 'fire' lunch boxes ×3 (Mon–Wed) + aji verde + peas and carrots (Sunday)
sideRecipes.serves: 3 grown-up lunches + Wendy's Tue bowl + Chloe's Tue fried rice
ingredients: 600 g lemon-oregano chicken (above), 360 g bone broth rice (today's batch)
Peas and carrots (~460 g cooked): 2 × 16 oz bags organic frozen peas and carrots (use ~480 g; rest stays frozen), 2 Tbsp bone broth, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp honey, squeeze of lemon

Aji verde (~250 g): 170 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt, 30 g cilantro (stems ok), 15 g grated parmesan, 15 g lime juice, 1 garlic clove, 3 g salt; blend smooth. Rory's spicy jar: blend ⅓ of it with ½ jalapeño if you have one.
steps: Peas and carrots: covered 10-in pan with the broth over medium 5–6 min until hot; season with salt, honey, lemon. Cool 10 min.
Blend the aji verde 30 s; pour into 4 small lidded steel cups (40 g each) + 1 jar for Tuesday (~70 g).
Each lunch container: 200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots; aji verde cup on top (fridge, Mon–Wed). Reheat 2–2½ min covered to 165°F, then add the aji verde cold.
Set aside 100 g peas and carrots for Wendy's Tue bowl and 40 g for Chloe's Tue fried rice.
Per lunch ≈ 580 cal · 72 g P · 47 g C · 10 g F (Rory's 'fire' numbers).

sideRecipes.title: Chloe's Monday jar: frozen mini meatballs + orzo (Sunday, 12 min)
ingredients: 5 frozen mini grass-fed beef meatballs (from the Oct 25 batch; ~22 are left in the freezer)
45 g dry orzo (on hand) → ~100 g cooked
¼ cup mild organic marinara (on hand), 1 tsp grated parmesan
steps: Cook the orzo 8–9 min in salted water; drain.
Container: 5 meatballs (straight from the freezer; they thaw overnight in the fridge), 100 g orzo, ¼ cup marinara (fridge).
Mon morning: heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 6–8 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar, parmesan on top.

sideRecipes.title: Optional: homemade protein bars ×6 (only if you didn't make them this week)
sideRecipes.serves: 6 bars (~65 g each) · ≈ 200 cal · 20 g P each (estimates)
ingredients: 120 g Noble vanilla beef isolate
60 g organic creamy almond butter (bought last week)
30 g organic almond flour (on hand)
30 g organic maple syrup
20 g organic mini dark chocolate chips (10 g in, 10 g on top)
40–60 g Grassmilk whole milk, 10 g at a time
2 g vanilla, pinch of salt
steps: Line an 8×4-in loaf pan with parchment.
Stir the almond butter, maple, vanilla and 40 g milk smooth; add the isolate, almond flour and salt; knead, adding milk 10 g at a time until it holds like play-dough.
Fold in 10 g chips, press firmly into the pan, press the other 10 g on top.
Chill 1 hr, cut 6 bars. Fridge 7 days or freezer 2 months.

dinners.name: Miso-honey-ginger wild salmon
dinners.desc: Wild sockeye with a mild white-miso, honey and ginger glaze, roasted at 425°F and flashed under the broiler. Bone broth rice from Sunday, sesame-garlic asparagus. Chili crisp on the side for Rory.

ingredients: 1.75 lb (800 g) wild-caught sockeye, cut in 4 portions (frozen on delivery; fridge Sunday morning)
Glaze (~65 g): 20 g white miso, 15 g honey, 10 g coconut aminos, 5 g fresh ginger grated, 1 garlic clove grated, 5 g lime juice

Sesame-garlic asparagus (~500 g cooked; Rory 150 · guest 150 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 50): 2 lb (2 bunches) asparagus, woody ends snapped; spray, ½ tsp salt, 1 garlic clove grated, 1 tsp (5 g) toasted sesame oil tossed on after roasting, 3 g toasted sesame seeds
420 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday) + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: chili crisp or sriracha on the side
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle; 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans. Whisk the glaze.
Asparagus on pan B: spray, salt, garlic; in at 5:05 on the lower rack, 12–14 min until tender-crisp, shaking once. Toss with the sesame oil and seeds.
Pat the salmon dry, skin-side down on pan A (sprayed), salt lightly, brush on ⅔ of the glaze.
5:10: salmon on the upper rack 9–11 min, then broil 1–2 min (watch it) until the glaze bubbles and the thickest part is 145°F / flakes. Pull Chloe's piece 2 min early. Brush on the rest of the glaze.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
Rory: 190 g cooked salmon, 120 g rice, 150 g asparagus ≈ 574 cal / 58 g P.

dinners.name: Car dinner after dance (Rory + Chloe) · Wendy's 'fire' bowl at home
dinners.desc: Lemon-oregano chicken wraps on Hero tortillas with aji verde and hummus, plus cucumber and pepper spears, eaten in the car. Wendy gets the 'fire' bowl at home: chicken, bone broth rice, peas and carrots, aji verde. No guests Tuesday.
dinners.side: Cucumber + red bell pepper spears (+ apple slices for Chloe)

recipe.serves: 3: Rory + Chloe in the car, Wendy at home
recipe.time: 15 min before you leave for dance
ingredients: 370 g lemon-oregano chicken, sliced (fridge, Sunday): Rory 160 g, Wendy 150 g, Chloe 60 g
3 Hero flour tortillas (44 g each): 2 Rory, 1 Chloe
Cedar's organic hummus: 30 g Rory, 15 g Chloe
Aji verde (Sunday jar): 30 g Rory (from his spicy jar), 40 g Wendy; none for Chloe
Spears: 1 English cucumber + 1 red bell pepper cut in sticks (~350 g; Rory 150 g, Chloe 100 g, a few into the wraps); 1 small apple sliced for Chloe
Wendy's bowl: 150 g chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 100 g peas and carrots (all from Sunday) + 40 g aji verde + lemon wedge
Packing: parchment, foil, insulated bag, napkins; Rory's hot sauce packet
steps: Warm Rory's and Chloe's chicken in a stainless skillet with 1 Tbsp broth 3–4 min to 165°F.
Warm the tortillas 15–20 s per side in a dry skillet. Spread hummus, add chicken, a few cucumber sticks and Rory's aji verde. Fold the sides and roll tight.
Toast seam-side down 1–2 min per side until sealed. Wrap in parchment, then foil. Eat within 2 hours.
Wendy: microwave her chicken + rice + peas and carrots covered 2–2½ min to 165°F; add the aji verde and lemon.
Rory: 2 wraps (88 g tortillas, 160 g chicken, 30 g hummus, 30 g aji verde) + 150 g spears ≈ 538 cal / 68 g P.

dinners.name: Grass-fed beef & broccoli
dinners.desc: Thin-sliced grass-fed sirloin seared hard in batches, glossy tamari-honey-ginger sauce thickened with gelatin and bone broth (no cornstarch, 1 tsp sesame oil), broth-steamed broccoli, Sunday's bone broth rice. Mild for Chloe; chili crisp on the side for Rory. Makes Thursday's lunches.

recipe.serves: 4 + 3 Thu lunches (100 g beef each) + Chloe's Thu jar (60 g)
ingredients: 2.5 lb (1.13 kg) grass-fed top sirloin (frozen on delivery; fridge Mon night), sliced ¼ in thick against the grain (easiest when still slightly firm)
½ tsp kosher salt + 1 Tbsp (15 g) tamari to toss the beef
Sauce: 180 g bone broth with 2 tsp (6 g) gelatin bloomed in it, 45 g low-sodium tamari, 20 g honey, 15 g fresh ginger grated, 4 garlic cloves grated, 10 g lime juice, 5 g (1 tsp) toasted sesame oil
Broccoli: 2.5 lb crowns cut in florets (~850 g), 120 g bone broth, ¼ tsp salt
450 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday) + 2 Tbsp broth; sliced green onion + sesame seeds to finish
Rory only: chili crisp on the side
steps: 5:00: toss the beef with the salt and 1 Tbsp tamari. Bloom the gelatin in the broth 5 min, then whisk in the rest of the sauce.
5:05: broccoli in a 12-in stainless skillet with the 120 g broth, covered, high heat 4–5 min until bright green and just tender. Salt; tip into a bowl.
5:12: wipe the pan, high heat 2 min, spray. Sear the beef in 3 batches in one layer, 60–90 s per side until browned; out to a plate.
5:22: pour the sauce in and boil 3–4 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon (the gelatin and honey make it glossy). Return the beef and its juices 1 min to 145°F, then fold in the broccoli.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
Before serving, pack Thursday: 3 lunch containers × (100 g beef + 100 g broccoli) and Chloe's 60 g beef + 40 g broccoli (fridge). Rice for those is the Thu rice from the freezer.
Rory: 170 g beef with sauce, 150 g broccoli, 130 g rice ≈ 577 cal / 58 g P.

dinners.name: Greek lemon-garlic chicken thighs + strained-yogurt tzatziki
dinners.desc: Air-chilled organic thighs marinated in lemon, garlic, oregano and a spoon of yogurt (no oil), roasted together on ONE pan so the juices pool. Sweet potato wedges on two pans, a tzatziki made with strained Kalona yogurt, and a cucumber-tomato-red onion salad. Makes Friday's lunches.
dinners.side: Roasted sweet potato wedges + cucumber-tomato-red onion salad

recipe.serves: 4 + 3 Fri lunches (180 g chicken + 120 g sweet potato each)
recipe.time: Marinate ≥2 hr (Wed night ok) · ~40 min at 425°F
ingredients: 3.5 lb (1.59 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken thighs (frozen on delivery; fridge Tue night)
Marinade: zest of 1 lemon + 45 g lemon juice, 6 garlic cloves grated, 3 g (1½ tsp) dried oregano, 2 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika, 10 g (1¾ tsp) kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 15 g Kalona yogurt. No oil.
Sweet potatoes: 3 lb (1.36 kg) in 1-in wedges (skin on), split across TWO parchment-lined pans, spray, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder

Tzatziki (~250 g): 300 g Kalona yogurt strained 1–2 hr in a paper-towel-lined sieve (→ ~170 g), ½ English cucumber grated, salted ¼ tsp and squeezed dry (~80 g), 1 garlic clove grated, 8 g fresh dill chopped, 10 g lemon juice, pinch of salt

Cucumber-tomato-red onion salad (~500 g; Rory 120 · guest 120 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 50 cucumber only): 1 English cucumber diced, 300 g Roma tomatoes diced, ¼ red onion sliced paper-thin and rinsed, 10 g lemon juice, 5 g red wine vinegar, ½ tsp dried oregano, ¼ tsp salt. No oil.
Rory only: Aleppo pepper or hot sauce on the side
steps: Wed night or Thu morning: toss the thighs with the marinade in a glass container (fridge, 2–24 hr). Thu morning: set the yogurt to strain in the fridge.
4:30: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle. Sweet potato wedges onto 2 parchment-lined pans (~680 g each), spray and season.
4:40: sweet potatoes in on the lower rack (side by side); thighs flat and snug on ONE sprayed, parchment-lined half-sheet pan on the upper rack.
Roast 30–35 min: thighs to 175°F; sweet potatoes until browned at the edges and soft inside, shaking at 15 and 25 min.
While it roasts: make the tzatziki and the salad (salad last, so it stays crisp).
5:15: thighs to a board. Pour the pan juices into a small skillet and boil 2–3 min until syrupy; spoon it over the chicken.
Pack Friday: 3 lunch containers × (180 g chicken + 120 g sweet potato) + 40 g tzatziki cups (fridge).
Rory: 170 g chicken, 180 g sweet potato, 50 g tzatziki, 120 g salad ≈ 537 cal / 49 g P.

dinners.name: Steak night: seared grass-fed sirloin + chimichurri
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('absolute banger'): hard-seared grass-fed top sirloin, low-oil chimichurri (red pepper flakes only in Rory's), oven-roasted Yukon potatoes at 425°F (oven, not air fryer), lemon-garlic green beans. Same as last week.
dinners.side: Oven-roasted Yukon potatoes + lemon-garlic green beans

ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) grass-fed top sirloin, ~1 in thick (frozen on delivery; fridge Wed night)
1¼ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, avocado-oil spray

Chimichurri (~150 g): 40 g flat-leaf parsley chopped fine, 3 garlic cloves minced, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30 g red wine vinegar, 15 g lemon juice, 27 g (2 Tbsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 30 g water, ½ tsp kosher salt, ¼ tsp pepper. Rory's portion: + ¼–½ tsp red pepper flakes. Make Thu night or Fri; rest 15 min+.
Potatoes: 800 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, spray, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika

Lemon-garlic green beans (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · guest ~100 · Wendy ~100 · Chloe ~50): 340 g green beans trimmed, ½ cup (120 g) bone broth, 3 garlic cloves sliced, zest of 1 lemon + 1 tsp juice, ⅓ tsp salt
steps: 4:45: salt the steaks; leave on the counter 30–40 min. Oven to 425°F.
5:00: potatoes in (both pans, upper-middle + lower-middle), 30–35 min, shaking at 15 and 25 min, swapping racks once, until deep golden.
5:20: green beans in a wide lidded pan with the broth and garlic: covered 6–7 min, uncover and cook off the liquid 1–2 min; zest, juice, salt.

5:20: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high 3 min, spray, sear the steaks 4–5 min per side (2 at a time) to 130–135°F for medium-rare (USDA: 145°F). Chloe's piece to 145°F if she prefers. Rest 5–10 min, slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak (Rory's from his spicy jar).
Rory: 170 g cooked sirloin, 180 g potatoes, 150 g green beans, 25 g chimichurri ≈ 585 cal / 59 g P.

dinners.name: Night out
dinners.desc: Saturday is our standing night out. No prep, nothing bought for it.

dinners.name: Next Sunday's batch cook (planned next Thursday)
dinners.desc: Sun Nov 8's cook gets planned (and shopped) with next Thursday's list. The guest is still here Nov 8; from Mon Nov 9 we're back to 3.

chloeLunches.items: 5 mini grass-fed beef meatballs + 100 g orzo in ¼ cup mild marinara, 1 tsp parmesan (container made Sunday, fridge); 1 small apple sliced + 1 kiwi
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 6–8 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar; parmesan on top. Fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild veggie egg fried rice: 100 g bone broth rice + 2 OrgaNICK eggs + 40 g peas and carrots (all from Sunday), 1 tsp coconut aminos, ½ tsp sesame oil; 1 mandarin + 4 strawberries
chloeLunches.how: Spray a 10-in pan, scramble the eggs soft and set aside; add the rice, peas and carrots and 1 Tbsp broth, 3–4 min until steaming; fold in the eggs, aminos and sesame oil (165°F). Pack hot.

chloeLunches.items: 4–5 Bell & Evans organic nuggets + ~100 g potato wedges, 2 Tbsp honey mustard (1 Tbsp honey + 1 Tbsp Dijon) in a steel dip cup, ½ mango in chunks
chloeLunches.how: Cut 1 Yukon potato (~180 g) into 8 wedges, spray, pinch of salt; air-fry 400°F 8 min. Add the nuggets from frozen, 10–12 min more at 400°F, shaking at 6 min, to 170°F (they're sold uncooked). Pack hot in the preheated jar; mango + dip in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Mild beef & broccoli: 60 g beef + 40 g broccoli (packed Wed night) over 100 g bone broth rice (frozen Sunday, fridge Wed night); 1 kiwi + a handful of blueberries
chloeLunches.how: Reheat covered with 1 Tbsp broth in a small saucepan 4–5 min (or microwave 1½–2 min), stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot; fruit in the bento.

breakfasts: Yogurt bowls: 170 g Kalona grass-fed whole-milk yogurt + 75 g berries + ½ kiwi, honey optional, no granola (~110 cal / 6 g P per 170 g yogurt, so pair with eggs).
Eggs: 2 dozen OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free (fried or scrambled with spray, 2–3 min); 2 go into Chloe's Tue fried rice. No egg bites this week.
Snacks: fruit, Creami thirds, and protein bars if you made them (optional Sunday batch below).
lunches: Grown-up lunches (3 each day): Mon–Wed Rory's 'fire' box (200 g lemon-oregano chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 100 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde, ≈ 580 cal / 72 g P); Thu 100 g beef & broccoli + 100 g broccoli + 120 g bone broth rice (packed Wed night; rice from the freezer); Fri 180 g Greek thighs + 120 g sweet potato + 40 g tzatziki (packed Thu night).

creami.name: Honey vanilla ×2 (creamier, more yogurt)
creami.desc: (per pint) 170 g organic low-fat cottage cheese, 150 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt, 60 g Grassmilk whole milk, 14 g honey, 2 g vanilla, pinch of salt, 24 g Noble vanilla beef isolate. ≈ 412 cal · 46 g P per pint; ⅓ ≈ 137 cal · 15 g P. More yogurt than last week, per Rory's note that the yogurt-heavy version spins creamier.

creami.name: Chocolate ×1 (Rory's 'fire' pint, now with Equip)
creami.desc: 230 g cottage cheese, 100 g milk, 60 g water, 10 g organic cocoa, 12 g maple syrup, 1 g vanilla, pinch of salt, 1 scoop (~28 g) Equip chocolate peanut butter beef protein in place of the Noble. ≈ 408 cal · 50 g P; ⅓ ≈ 136 cal · 17 g P (Equip counted as ~100 cal / 20 g P per scoop from Equip's labels).

creami.name: Pistachio ×1 (Wendy)
creami.desc: 220 g cottage cheese, 110 g milk, 40 g water, 32 g pistachio butter (ON HAND), 8 g honey, 1 g vanilla, pinch of salt, 24 g Noble. ≈ 550 cal · 54 g P; ⅓ ≈ 183 cal · 18 g P.

creami.name: Mango ×1 (pure mango)
creami.desc: 300 g ripe mango chunks (~1½ mangoes), 120 g cottage cheese, 40 g milk, 5 g lime juice, 24 g Noble, no honey. Spin Lite Ice Cream. ≈ 392 cal · 37 g P; ⅓ ≈ 131 cal · 12 g P.

creami.name: Strawberry-honey ×1 (new)
creami.desc: 220 g hulled strawberries, 150 g cottage cheese, 80 g Kalona yogurt, 10 g honey, 5 g lemon juice, 24 g Noble. Blend until no seeds of fruit are left whole. Spin Lite Ice Cream; re-spin with 15 g milk. ≈ 370 cal · 41 g P; ⅓ ≈ 123 cal · 14 g P.

creami.name: Notes
creami.desc: Make Sunday, freeze level 24 h. Blend each base 30–45 s, fill to the max line. Re-spin with 15–30 g milk if crumbly. Totals for 6 pints: cottage cheese ~1,060 g · Kalona ~380 g · milk ~370 g · Noble 120 g (+120 g if you make the bars) · 1 scoop Equip chocolate PB · mango 300 g · strawberries 220 g · cocoa 10 g · maple 12 g · honey 46 g. Macros are estimates (Noble 24 g ≈ 90 cal / 20 g P).

prep.title: Delivery day
prep.step: FREEZE on arrival: salmon, both sirloin packs (2.5 lb for Wed, 2 lb for Fri), the thighs, nuggets. FRIDGE: ground beef + chicken breasts (cooked Sunday).

prep.title: Salmon to the fridge
prep.step: Move the 1.75 lb salmon from the freezer to the fridge (on a plate) so it's thawed for Monday.

prep.title: Bone broth rice (big batch)
prep.step: Rinse 600 g jasmine. Two 4-qt saucepans, each with 300 g rice + 515 g bone broth + ½ tsp salt. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min → ~2,150 g. Spread on 2 sheet pans to cool (fridge within 1 hr).

prep.title: Lunch chicken (air fryer)
prep.step: Season 3 lb air-chilled breasts lemon-oregano; air-fry 380°F 14–18 min per batch at ~1:10, 1:30 and 1:50, to 165°F. Rest, slice.

prep.title: Creami bases (6 pints)
prep.step: While the chicken cooks: blend and fill 2 honey vanilla, 1 chocolate (Equip), 1 pistachio, 1 mango, 1 strawberry-honey. Lids on, freeze level. ~35 min.

prep.title: Aji verde + peas and carrots
prep.step: Blend the aji verde (170 g Kalona, 30 g cilantro, 15 g parmesan, 15 g lime, 1 garlic, 3 g salt); portion into 4 cups of 40 g + a Tuesday jar. Steam ~480 g frozen peas and carrots with 2 Tbsp broth 5–6 min; season; cool.

prep.title: Chloe's Monday orzo
prep.step: Cook 45 g orzo 8–9 min; drain. Container: 5 frozen meatballs + 100 g orzo + ¼ cup marinara (fridge).

prep.title: Portion + label
prep.step: FRIDGE: 3 'fire' lunch boxes (200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas/carrots + aji cup) · Tue chicken 370 g · Wendy Tue 120 g rice + 100 g peas/carrots · Chloe Tue 100 g rice + 40 g peas/carrots · Mon dinner rice 420 g · Wed dinner rice 450 g · Chloe's Mon jar · aji verde jar. FREEZER: Thu rice 460 g (Chloe 100 + 3 × 120). Keep 240 g rice out for tonight. Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 11/1'.

prep.title: Optional protein bars
prep.step: Only if you didn't make them this week: mix, press into a lined 8×4 loaf pan, chill 1 hr, cut 6 (fridge).

prep.title: Fruit + clean up
prep.step: Wash and cut fruit for the week's bowls (kiwi, strawberries, blueberries); leave mangoes and apples whole. Clean up. Everything cooked is put away by ~3:30. Break until 4:55.

prep.title: Cheeseburger bowls
prep.step: Bloom the gelatin, mix the burger sauce, chop the romaine, tomatoes and pickles, shred the cheddar.

prep.title: Cook + plate
prep.step: Brown the beef with onion, spices, ketchup, mustard and gelatin to 160°F; dry-cook the riced cauliflower 7–8 min and fold in 140 g rice. Dinner ~5:20.

prep.title: Thaw + marinate schedule
prep.step: Mon night: 2.5 lb sirloin → fridge (Wed). Tue night: thighs → fridge (Thu). Wed night: marinate the thighs; Thu rice (460 g) → fridge; 2 lb sirloin → fridge (Fri); pack Thu lunches. Thu AM: strain the yogurt. Thu night: chimichurri; pack Fri lunches. Wed AM: nuggets straight from the freezer.

prepNote: Sun Nov 1: no roast this week, so it's a shorter cook. Rice, lunch chicken, 6 Creami, aji verde, peas and carrots and Chloe's Monday jar 1:00–3:30; cheeseburger bowls cooked fresh at 5:00.

lunchIntro: Each morning: fill the 12 oz thermal jar with boiling water for 5–10 min, then dump it. Heat the hot food to 165°F (steaming), pack it into the warmed jar, and close it. Cold food goes in the steel bento with an ice pack, and everything goes in the insulated bag.
prepIntro: Times assume a 1:00 PM start and dinner around 5:20 PM. About 2½ hours hands-on plus 25 minutes for dinner; there's no oven braise this week, so you get a break mid-afternoon. Tuesday is the car dinner (15 min), Saturday is the night out, and Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri dinners are cooked fresh (25–40 min each).
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); ground beef 160°F; salmon 145°F; steak 130–135°F medium-rare (USDA 145°F); reheated leftovers 165°F. Bell & Evans nuggets are sold uncooked: cook to 170°F.
Cool fast: spread rice on sheet pans; everything into the fridge within 1–2 hours (rice within 1 hour).
Fridge = eaten Mon–Wed. Freezer = Thu onward (Thu rice). Wed/Thu dinners pack the next day's lunches; Fri's lunches are eaten within 1 day.
Reheat each portion only once. Label every container with dish, day, grams and 'cooked 11/1'.
prepThaw: Sat Oct 31 (delivery): freeze the salmon, both sirloins and the thighs right away; ground beef and breasts go in the fridge for Sunday.
Mon night: 2.5 lb sirloin → fridge (for Wed).
Tue night: 3.5 lb thighs → fridge (for Thu).
Wed night: marinate the thighs; Thu rice (460 g) → fridge; 2 lb sirloin → fridge (for Fri).
Thu morning: strain 300 g Kalona for the tzatziki. Thu night: make the chimichurri.
Saturday: night out, nothing to thaw.
